description: This Java file defines an Android activity 'PolyToPoly' that demonstrates the use of the Matrix class's 'setPolyToPoly' method to perform various geometric transformations in a custom View 'SampleView'. The sample includes drawing rectangles, lines, and text which are transformed with different matrix operations to illustrate graphics transformations.

classes.name: PolyToPoly
classes.description: Main activity extending GraphicsActivity, responsible for setting the content view to a custom drawing view.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Inner custom View class that performs the drawing demonstrating 'setPolyToPoly' matrix transformations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the content view to an instance of SampleView.

methods.name: doDraw
methods.description: Helper method that applies a 'setPolyToPoly' transformation and draws graphics and text to illustrate the transformation.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes paint objects used for drawing.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides View's onDraw to perform the sequence of transformations and drawings.
